partner.line: Where are the hands from before?

stanza: In a rainstorm
Suckin' down a dart on the back porch
Out here, it gets so dark
You can see the stars, the ones
The headlines said this morning
Were bein' spat out by what we thought
Was just destroyin' everything for good

partner.line: Suckin' down a dart on the back porch

q.songTitle: Tell the Devil I’m Gettin’ There as Fast as I Can
q.line: Bein' in love with her is like living in a thunderstorm
stanza: I met her in L.A., we was openin' for Son Volt
She had eyes mascara'd like Eva Green’s
She sparkled with wildness like the blue yonder
She'd done a time in darkness and was two years clean
She wears an old leather jacket, it was made by Irish saints
And boots engraved with skulls and thorns
She got her ink in Tulsa, still she don't like red-dirt bands
Bein' in love with her is like living in a thunderstorm

partner.line: And boots engraved with skulls and thorns

q.line: Lightning pushes the edge of a thunderstorm
stanza: I believe in the future I may live in my car
My radio tuned to the voice of a star
Sundogs barking at the break of dawn
Lightning pushes the edge of a thunderstorm
And these old hopes and fears still at my side

partner.line: Sundogs barking at the break of dawn

q.line: Back then, a man in uniform
stanza: We used to spend the night in town
Down by city hall
And the water works of Irish Beach
Just below the falls
We'd walk down to the Park Hotel
Past the Baptist Veteran's Mall
Back then, a man in uniform
Might mean anything at all
And if you call me brother now
Forgive me if I inquire
"Just according to whose plan?"
When it all comes down to dust
I will kill you if I must
I will help you if I can
When it all comes down to dust
I will help you if I must
I will kill you if I can
And mercy on our uniform
Man of peace or man of war
The peacock spreads his fan

partner.line: Man of peace or man of war

q.line: Who'd like to change his clothes into a uniform?
stanza: Is there anybody here
Who'd like to change his clothes into a uniform?
Is there anybody here
Who thinks they're only serving on a raging storm?
Is there anybody here with glory in their eyes
Loyal to the end, whose duty is to die?

partner.line: Who thinks they're only serving on a raging storm?

stanza: And I dreamt one night
You were there in fours
Head held high
In uniform
Fifteen minutes of fame or
Fifteen minutes away from
Findin' love in a waveform
Is you someone to wait for?

partner.line: Is you someone to wait for?
